convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Fisher_org_v1 custom indicator, depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close/position sizing), and uses custom CIsNewBar class from that library.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal time assignment
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Signal-based close: BUY_Close triggered when indicator line crosses below signal line; SELL_Close triggered when indicator line crosses above signal line

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT (4): MM value is treated as fixed lot size; MMMode=FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE: MM value is treated as a fraction (percentage) of the respective margin base for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses previous two bars: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (previous bar indicator above signal) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current bar indicator at or below signal) for BUY_Open crossover detection. The SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar offset is used as the 'current' bar for signal reading, effectively adding a 1-bar delay. When SignalBar=0, the EA processes on every tick without waiting for a new bar. Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) and the CIsNewBar class all come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - their internal position checks and margin logic are not visible in this file. GlobalVariableDel_ on deinit suggests the library tracks state via global variables.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement Fisher_org_v1 indicator logic (not available in this file - need the indicator source). Must also reimplement all TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_. The MMMode conditional sizing logic is inside the library and needs reverse-engineering or replacement with a standard risk-percent/fixed-lot implementation. Signal logic is crossover-based and straightforward once indicator buffers are replicated. The SignalBar=1 default means signals are read from bar[1] and bar[2], adding a 1-bar lag - this must be preserved in Python. No digit adjustment logic is visible in this EA, but the library may handle it internally.
